changelog.zh:
- 重构：去交错功能改用 videoParams 流动态检测源类型（1080i/1080p/2160p），按源分流配置
- 新增：1080i 隔行源软件去交错支持（bwdif→yadif→lavfi:yadif 优先级链，自动回退硬件去交错）
- 修复：4K SDR 画面过曝泛白问题，改用动态 HDR/SDR 色彩空间检测
- 修复：Flutter 帧调度断言失败（schedulerPhase == midFrameMicrotasks）
- 优化：Provider 在 build 阶段的 notifyListeners 调用包裹 addPostFrameCallback，避免 setState during build
- 移除：去交错模式选择器（因 mpv 构建限制，改用自动检测）
- 升级：切换至完整版 libmpv（zhongfly/mpv-winbuild），支持 libavfilter 和 msg-level
changelog.en:
- Refactor: Deinterlace now dynamically detects source type (1080i/1080p/2160p) via videoParams stream for per-source configuration
- New: Software deinterlacing for 1080i sources (bwdif→yadif→lavfi:yadif priority chain with automatic hardware fallback)
- Fix: 4K SDR overexposure/washed-out issue by dynamic HDR/SDR color space detection
- Fix: Flutter frame scheduling assertion failure (schedulerPhase == midFrameMicrotasks)
- Optimization: Wrap notifyListeners in addPostFrameCallback during build phase to prevent setState during build
- Removed: Deinterlace mode selector (replaced by automatic detection due to mpv build limitations)
- Upgrade: Switch to full libmpv build (zhongfly/mpv-winbuild) with libavfilter and msg-level support
